panel.root_hash_contract: every root state hash is checked against the frozen v14 compact certificate
panel.root_states: greedy fixed point per input; raw normalized listing when the input exceeds the baseline gate budget
panel.source: E45 fixed panel (96 E39 + 32 E44 sources in screening order)

purpose: Position-resolved certified landscape: which windows of the E45 root listings are exact local optima within a finite horizon and which hide a certified escape.  Window claims are window-local by construction.

resource_contracts.determinism: per-window results are deterministic; output ordering is sorted by source, width, start, horizon

search_contract.reverse_edges: not used; rank-increasing reverse Quartz parameter-splitting remains illegal
search_contract.witness_replay: every EXACT_ESCAPE window witness is replayed in-runner; failure aborts
search_contract.witness_storage: only the first escape certificate per (source, width, horizon) is stored; the deterministic runner regenerates the complete witness set on demand

window_contract.boundary_semantics: actions consuming gates outside the slice are invisible to the window
window_contract.definition: contiguous slice of the root listing, normalized per gate
window_contract.sampling: stride 1 up to 1024 windows per input, then ceil(gates/1024)
